newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Nam Pei Hong postpones results to Jan 10.
newsitem.headline: Nam Pei Hong postpones results to Jan 10.

text.p: Chinese medicine retailer Nam Pei Hong (Holdings) Ltd said on Monday it had postponed its board meeting to approve its interim results to January 10 from January 6.
The company previously postponed the board meeting from December 30 to January 6.
Nam Pei Hong said auditors experienced delays in completing their audit of the company's financial statements for the six months ended September 30, 1996.

It said extra audit work was required due to an exceptional loss caused by a shortfall in inventories and allegations of wrongdoing at the time of the stock-taking carried out for the audited accounts for the year ended March 31, 1996.

On December 27, Nam Pei Hong said it had filed a report with police after one of its major wholly-owned retailing and wholesaling units posted a HK$58 million exceptional loss resulting from a shortfall in inventories.
Nam Pei Hong shares have been suspended at the company's request since December 23 and ended their last trading day on December 20 at HK$0.46. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6370
